Open claude's terminal UI on a chosen session
Conversation history; grows without bound, gets the headroom

install.command:
set -e
ws="${WORKSPACE_DIR:-/}"
esc=$(printf '%s' "$ws" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g')
projects="\"/\": { \"hasTrustDialogAccepted\": true }"
[ "$ws" = "/" ] || projects="$projects, \"$esc\": { \"hasTrustDialogAccepted\": true }"
printf '%s\n' "{
  \"bypassPermissionsModeAccepted\": true,
  \"hasCompletedOnboarding\": true,
  \"projects\": { $projects }
}" > /home/agent/.claude.json
chown agent:agent /home/agent/.claude.json
install.description: Seed Claude bypass/trust flags (root; overwrites image-shipped file)
Ensure ~/.claude is agent-owned before settings seed

install.command:
set -e
HELPER=''
if [ "${SBX_CRED_ANTHROPIC_MODE:-none}" != none ]; then
  HELPER='  "apiKeyHelper": "echo proxy-managed",
'
fi
# Model selection from the create-phase args. The args'
# patterns admit no quote or backslash, so the expanded
# value is safe inside the JSON string. effortLevel accepts
# low/medium/high/xhigh; max and auto persist only through
# CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL (settings.json rejects them).
model='${{ kit.args.model }}'
effort='${{ kit.args.reasoningEffort }}'
MODEL=''
EFFORT=''
ENV_BLOCK=''
[ -z "$model" ] || MODEL="  \"model\": \"$model\",
"
case "$effort" in
  '') ;;
  max|auto)
    ENV_BLOCK="  \"env\": { \"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL\": \"$effort\" },
"
    ;;
  *)
    EFFORT="  \"effortLevel\": \"$effort\",
"
    ;;
esac
# Lifecycle hooks for sbx Desktop (see /usr/local/bin/sbx-claude-hook):
# Stop and StopFailure report a finished turn, Notification the
# moments Claude waits on the user, UserPromptSubmit the prompt
# that names the conversation (Claude Code lists sessions by id
# only). The script never fails, never writes stdout and runs
# async, so a session without the desktop app sees no delay and
# no hook error.
HOOK='{ "type": "command", "command": "/usr/local/bin/sbx-claude-hook claude", "timeout": 10, "async": true }'
HOOKS="  \"hooks\": {
    \"Stop\": [ { \"hooks\": [ $HOOK ] } ],
    \"StopFailure\": [ { \"hooks\": [ $HOOK ] } ],
    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [ { \"hooks\": [ $HOOK ] } ],
    \"Notification\": [ { \"matcher\": \"permission_prompt|idle_prompt|elicitation_dialog|elicitation_url_dialog|agent_needs_input\", \"hooks\": [ $HOOK ] } ]
  },
"
# The statusLine command is the only place Claude Code exposes
# the live session (model, context window, cost, lines changed);
# sbx-agent-hook forwards it to sbx Desktop's status bar and prints
# nothing, so no status line is drawn in the terminal. A mixin that
# sets its own statusLine (e.g. claude-sbx-statusline) replaces
# this one and the app's session view goes quiet for that sandbox.
STATUSLINE="  \"statusLine\": { \"type\": \"command\", \"command\": \"/usr/local/bin/sbx-claude-hook claude-status\" },
"
printf '%s' "{
  \"themeId\": 1,
  \"alwaysThinkingEnabled\": true,
${HELPER}${MODEL}${EFFORT}${ENV_BLOCK}${HOOKS}${STATUSLINE}  \"permissions\": { \"defaultMode\": \"bypassPermissions\" },
  \"bypassPermissionsModeAccepted\": true,
  \"skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt\": true
}
" > /home/agent/.claude/settings.json
install.description: Seed Claude settings.json from the surfaced auth mode

install.command:
set -e
[ -n "$MCP_GATEWAY_URL" ] || exit 0
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.claude/local:$PATH"
claude mcp add mcp-gateway "$MCP_GATEWAY_URL" \
  --transport http \
  --scope user \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_SENTINEL_TOKEN_NAME" || true
install.description: Register the sandbox MCP gateway (install-time, race-free)
